after.description: Start where an earlier JSON call stopped: its `cursor`, verbatim

order.description: Id of an order in the local store

since.description: How far back to replay first, in minutes (1 to 10080, default 30)

timeout.description: Deadline in seconds, counted from the end of the first replay (1 to 86400): JSON returns at the first new records or empty at it (default 30); human mode stops at it, and has no deadline without it
